page.notes: The left-hand column is partly obscured by the scan's damage; some small capital lines at the foot are only partly legible. The left-hand entries, "In ea, tem- ple Plinio, Signa erant", stand as a side column beside the brace; the bottom strip of tiny inscription lines is not transcribed in full because it is too small to read reliably. Numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 are line counts in the right margin.
